lines.japanese: 馴らし運転とでも言うのか、渡来明日香と別れたあと、適当にグローヴ街をぶらついてみた。
lines.english: Another break-in run, I suppose. After parting with Asuka Watarai, I wandered Grove Street without any particular destination.

lines.japanese: 小一時間ほどして、小腹が減ってきた。
lines.english: After an hour or so, I began to feel peckish.

lines.japanese: 可愛い妹が美味しい夕食を作って待っている。あんまりがっつり詰めこむわけにはいかない。アレキサンダーなら軽食もとれるけど、今日は木曜・定休日だ。
lines.english: My adorable sister was waiting at home with a delicious dinner. I could not stuff myself too full. Alexander served light meals, but today was Thursday, its regular closing day.

lines.japanese: そんなわけでここに来た。
lines.english: And so I came here.

lines.japanese: 今後のことを考えれば、いずれ顔を出す必要があるだろうとは思っていたんだ。
lines.english: Given what lay ahead, I had known I would eventually need to show my face here.

lines.japanese: ちょうど客足が遠のいていたところらしく、カウンターの前にはりついていたのは御一名様。近所のお嬢学校の学生。俺は古臭いテクノを鳴らす、成田工務店の窓口へと近付いていった。
lines.english: Business appeared to have just died down. Only one customer lingered at the counter: a student from the nearby girls' school. I approached the Narita Construction reception desk, with its antiquated techno music.

lines.japanese: 「えー、それでですねー、宅配員の方が持ってきてくれたんですけどー、私も家政婦の長宗我部さんもいなかったもので、お隣りさんが預かってくれたらしいんですよー」
lines.english: “So, you see, the deliveryman brought it, but neither I nor our housekeeper, Ms. Chosokabe, was home, so apparently the neighbors took it for us.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、今なんてポストに配達表一枚ブッ込んで終わりってな風潮なのに、そんなあったかい文化もまだあったんだねえ」
lines.english: “Huh. These days they usually stuff one missed-delivery slip in your mailbox and call it a job. Nice to know that warm old custom still survives.”

lines.japanese: 学生は見覚えのある顔だった。隼人が二週間ぐらい前にここで会った子だ。ホーメイだかコーメイだかいう、鳳翔の妹──
lines.english: The student looked familiar. Hayato had met her here two weeks or so ago. Kakeru Otori's little sister, named Homei or Komei or something—

lines.japanese: ──あ、姓は鳳だから、ホーメイじゃなくてオオトリナルか。鳳鳴、彼女はいつの間にかパルクレープの常連になっていたみたいだ。店主のパル氏とずいぶん親しげに会話している。
lines.english: —oh. Her surname was Otori, so not Homei. Naru Otori. At some point, she had apparently become a regular at Paru Crêpes. She was chatting with Paru, the owner, like an old friend.

lines.japanese: 「やー、それはいいんですけどー、うちマンションなんで、お隣りさんっていったらすぐ隣りの部屋かと思うじゃないですかー」
lines.english: “Yeah, that would've been fine, except we live in an apartment. When somebody says the neighbors, you'd assume they meant the room next door, right?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ普通はそうだなあ」
lines.english: “Normally, yes.”

lines.japanese: 「それが隣りの部屋も不在だったらしくて、マンションの横にある一軒家の方に預けたらしいんですねー。もー気づくのに丸一日かかって、今から取りにいかないといけないんですよー」
lines.english: “But no one was home in the next apartment either, so apparently they left it at a detached house beside the *entire building*. It took me a whole day to work that out, and now I have to go collect it.”

lines.japanese: うろたえる鳳鳴を相手に、かかかと笑うパル店主。おいおい待ってくれよ、やけに楽しそうじゃないか。よし、客のふりしてさりげなく会話に加わっちゃうぞう。
lines.english: Paru answered the flustered Naru Otori with a booming cackle. Hold on. They were having entirely too much fun. Good. I would pose as a customer and slip casually into the conversation.

lines.japanese: 「シナモンチョコレート」
lines.english: “Cinnamon chocolate.”

lines.japanese: 「やー、どうでしょう。品物の中身はまだ分かりませんねー、確かにチョコレートならいいんですけどー」
lines.english: “Well, who knows? I haven't seen what's inside the package. It certainly would be nice if it were chocolate—”

lines.japanese: 「じゃなくてシナモンチョコレートクレープ」
lines.english: “No. A cinnamon-chocolate crêpe.”

lines.japanese: 「やー、くれと言われましても、品物がチョコレートかどうか本当に分かりませんのでー」
lines.english: “Well, even if you ask me to give it to you, I truly don't know whether the package contains chocolate—”

lines.japanese: 「って、ええっ！　ドラさん！？」
lines.english: “Wait, what!? Dora!?”

lines.japanese: 鳳鳴はマニュアル通りの驚き芸を１セットやってのけた。あれ？　この子、前に会ったときよりノリ良くなってる？　いや、うん、楽しいことはいいことだぞ。
lines.english: Naru Otori performed one full set of surprise reactions exactly according to the manual. Hm? Was she better at playing along than when I met her before? Well, yes. Fun was a good thing.

lines.japanese: 「よっ、久しぶり。元気？　平和？　青春？」
lines.english: “Hey. Long time no see. Healthy? Peaceful? Youthful?”

lines.japanese: 俺はカウンターに腕を預けて鳳鳴の隣りに立った。目潰しピースを唇に添えてから、涼風のような投げキッス。ウィンク付き。
lines.english: I rested one arm on the counter beside Naru Otori. I touched two fingers to my lips, then jabbed the peace sign playfully toward her eyes and blew her a kiss like a cool breeze, wink included.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、あれー？　ドラさん感じ変わりましたー？」
lines.english: “H-huh? Dora, did something about you change?”

lines.japanese: 「うん？　ああ、よく分かったな。もともと二枚目だったのが、超二枚目に脱皮したんだ」
lines.english: “Hm? Oh, you noticed. I was always handsome, but I've molted into Super Handsome.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、いえ外見ではなく頭の中がー、その、現段階では悪い方にー」
lines.english: “Oh, I didn't mean your appearance. I meant the inside of your head. At present, the change seems to be for the worse.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、鳳鳴も感じ変わったなー、その、現段階では悪い方にー」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! You've changed too, Naru Otori. At present, the change seems to be for the worse.”

lines.japanese: 俺は笑ってごまかした。隼人とは大して話したことなかったはずだけど、なかなか洞察力に優れた子だ。
lines.english: I laughed and bluffed my way past the remark. She could hardly have spoken much with Hayato, yet her powers of observation were impressive.

lines.japanese: 「はー、今日はどうしたんですか、ドラさんしばらく来てなかったじゃないですかー」
lines.english: “So what brings you here today? You haven't come by in ages.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、俺がしばらく来てなかったってよく分かるな」
lines.english: “Huh. How do you know I haven't been here in ages?”

lines.japanese: 「ふふー、私、毎日来てますからー。もうドラさんより常連、脱皮して超常連ですよー」
lines.english: “Hee hee. I come every day now. I'm more of a regular than you. I've molted into a super-regular.”

lines.japanese: ははは、行儀悪いぞー、食うか喋るかどっちかにしろー。
lines.english: Ha ha ha. Mind your manners. Either eat or talk; pick one.

lines.japanese: しかし気持ちは分かる。彼女の口の周りについたチョコレートに、俺も食欲をそそられた。俄然クレープが待ち遠しくなるが、いつまでたっても注文した品が出てこない。
lines.english: Still, I understood. The chocolate around her mouth had whetted my appetite too. Suddenly I could hardly wait for my crêpe, yet no matter how long I waited, my order did not appear.

lines.japanese: 「うっはー、おなか空いたぞーう！　はやく俺もこの子みたいに、口や顔や五臓六腑をチョコレートまみれでベッタベタにしたいなあー！」
lines.english: “Whew, I'm starving! I can't wait to be like this girl and get my mouth, face, and every organ in my body plastered sticky with chocolate!”

lines.japanese: 待ちかねた俺が聞こえよがしに声を張りあげると、鳳鳴はあわててハンカチで口をぬぐった。だけど肝心のパル店主は、腰に手を当てたきりぴくりとも動こうとしなかった。
lines.english: Unable to wait any longer, I raised my voice for the owner to hear. Naru Otori hurriedly wiped her mouth with a handkerchief. But Paru, the person who mattered, kept one hand planted on her hip and showed no sign of moving.

lines.japanese: 「だったらクレープ屋にでも行ったらどうだい。あんたの注文なんざ、ここに居たって百年経っても出てきやしないよ」
lines.english: “Then go to a crêpe shop or something. You could sit here for a hundred years and your order still wouldn't come.”

lines.japanese: はて。いま俺はなに屋さんに来たんだっけ。パルクレープのメニュー表を持ちあげ、裏側までじろじろ仔細に眺めまわしてみた。
lines.english: Hm. What kind of establishment had I entered, again? I picked up the Paru Crêpes menu and scrutinized it front and back.

lines.japanese: 「なんだい、うちの看板になんか文句でもあんのかい」
lines.english: “What? You got a complaint about my sign?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、もしかして話に夢中で、俺の注文が聞こえてなかったのかな。そう、それだ。ようし、じゃあもう一回言っちゃうぞ」
lines.english: “Ah! Perhaps you were so absorbed in the conversation that you didn't hear my order. Yes. That must be it. Good, then. I'll say it again.”

lines.japanese: 「シナモンチョコレート一丁！」
lines.english: “One cinnamon chocolate!”
Thud!

lines.japanese: 目の前に袋詰めの白い塊が置かれた。というより叩きつけられた。正面に赤い文字で「業務用食塩」と書いてある。
lines.english: A bagged white mass appeared in front of me—or rather, was slammed down. Red letters across the front read FOOD-SERVICE SALT.

lines.japanese: 「シナ、モン……？」
lines.english: “Cinna... mon...?”

lines.japanese: 「さっきからガタガタうるさいんだよ、このトンチキが、ああ～？　鳴ッ！　その塩、この男の顔にかけてとっとと追いかえしちまいな！」
lines.english: “You've been rattling on and on, you prize idiot. Huh? Naru! Throw that salt in his face and send him packing!”

lines.japanese: 「こだわり頑固おやじの店！？」
lines.english: “A shop run by one of those stubborn artisan masters!?”

lines.japanese: パル店主にいわれもなく凄まれて、思わず俺は鳳鳴の後ろへ身を隠してしまった。盾にされた彼女もまた、不思議そうに首をひねっている。
lines.english: Paru snarled at me without apparent cause, and I instinctively hid behind Naru Otori. The girl, now employed as my shield, tilted her head in equal confusion.

lines.japanese: 「えーと、確かに今日のドラさんは感じ悪いですけど、パルさんのお怒りを買うような失態はまだやらかしてないかとー」
lines.english: “Well, Dora is unpleasant today, but I don't believe he's yet committed any offense that should earn Paru's wrath.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだそうだ！　横暴だぞ、店が客を選ぶんじゃない！」
lines.english: “Exactly! This is tyranny! A shop doesn't get to choose its customers!”

lines.japanese: 俺は勇敢に抗議した。鳳盾の後ろから。
lines.english: I protested courageously from behind the Naru Shield.

lines.japanese: 「ああッ！？　おぅドラ、まさか身に覚えがないなんて言うんじゃないだろうね！」
lines.english: “What!? Dora, don't tell me you have no idea what you did!”

lines.japanese: ない。全くない。隼人はもちろん、他の誰の身にも覚えなんてない。だけど素直にそのまま答えたら、このクルマを急発進させて突っこんできそうな剣幕だった。
lines.english: I had none. None whatsoever. Neither Hayato nor any of the others remembered anything. But if I said so honestly, she looked angry enough to start the truck and ram it into me.

lines.japanese: 「はっ！？　まさかパルさん、ドラさんの子を身ごもって！？」
lines.english: “What!? Paru, don't tell me you're pregnant with Dora's child!”

lines.japanese: 盾は盾でわけのわからないことを言いはじめた。
lines.english: The shield began saying incomprehensible things of her own.

lines.japanese: 「道理でパルさんのおなかが初めてお会いしたときより若干膨らんでいると思ったら！」
lines.english: “No wonder I thought Paru's belly had grown slightly since the first time we met!”

lines.japanese: 「おい。そんな事実はどこにもねえよ」
lines.english: “Hey. None of that is true.”

lines.japanese: 今度は鳳鳴が俺を盾にする番だった。
lines.english: This time, Naru Otori used me as her shield.

lines.japanese: 「もはは、それはまことか店主？　永年の独り寝を持てあまし、らもらもと夜の街に立ったことが一度ならずあるのではないか？　腹に手を当て顧みるがよい」
lines.english: “Mohaha! Is this true, shopkeeper? Has the burden of sleeping alone all these years driven thee, all aflutter, onto the streets by night on more than one occasion? Lay a hand upon thy belly and reflect!”

lines.japanese: そして俺と鳳鳴は、互いの体を前面へ押しだそうと争っていた。
lines.english: And so Naru Otori and I struggled to push each other's body to the front.

lines.japanese: 「その前にあんたは、自分の胸に手を当てて考えてみるんだね。よーッく思い出してみな。あんたさ、なにか頼まれごと忘れてないかい」
lines.english: “Before that, put a hand on your own chest and think. Remember carefully. Haven't you forgotten something somebody asked you to do?”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　頼まれごと？　なんすかそれ」
lines.english: “What? A request? What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「ああもう、じれったい男だね！　あんた、鳴坊の自転車探しすっかり忘れてンだろ！」
lines.english: “Oh, you infuriating man! You've completely forgotten about looking for Naru's bicycle!”
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: 思わず盾と目を合わせた。
lines.english: I instinctively met the shield's eyes.

lines.japanese: 自転車探し……ああ、そういえば隼人がそんな依頼を……いや、ビジネスとしては引き受けなかったけど、気持ち程度には協力するって話でまとまったんだった。二週間ぐらい前に。
lines.english: The bicycle... Oh, yes. Hayato had received that request. No: he had refused it as a proper job, but agreed to help in whatever small way he could. About two weeks ago.

lines.japanese: 「え、うそ……アレまだ探してんの」
lines.english: “Wait, seriously...? You're still looking for that?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、あのえとー……そう、ですね」
lines.english: “Oh, well... Yes.”

lines.japanese: 鳳鳴は途端に白々しい笑顔をこしらえた。ああ、そうだ。この子、二週間前に会ったときはこんな笑い方してたっけ。
lines.english: Naru Otori instantly assembled a blatantly false smile. Oh, yes. This was how she had smiled when I met her two weeks ago.

lines.japanese: 「たはは……」
lines.english: “Ha ha...”

lines.japanese: そうか。彼女が毎日ここへ足繁く通っていたのは、もしかしたら、俺からの報告があるかもしれないと期待していたせいだろうか。
lines.english: I see. Had she been coming here every day because she hoped I might arrive with news?

lines.japanese: こんな時間こんな場所にいるのも、いままでひとりで街中探していたせいなのかもしれない。あれから二週間、彼女はずっとこんな感じだったのだろうか。
lines.english: Perhaps she was here at this hour because she had spent the day searching the city alone. Had every day of the last two weeks been like this?

lines.japanese: 「ごめん！」
lines.english: “I'm sorry!”

lines.japanese: 「へっ」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん、友達が困ってるのに無責任だった。今度からは、歩くときとか気を付ける。見つかるかどうかは分からないけど、そうだな、見つからなくても週一ぐらいでここへ、報告には来るようにしよう」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. My friend was in trouble, and I was irresponsible. From now on, I'll keep my eyes open whenever I'm walking around. I can't promise I'll find it, but even if I don't, I'll come here about once a week and report in.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな感じでどうだろうか」
lines.english: “How does that sound?”

lines.japanese: 揃って口を開けている女たちに確認した。俺に声をかけられてようやく、ふたりはっとしたように目を合わせた。
lines.english: I sought confirmation from the two women, both staring with their mouths open. Only when I addressed them did they seem to awaken and exchange glances.

lines.japanese: 「は、はいっ。はい、はいっ」
lines.english: “Y-yes! Yes, yes!”

lines.japanese: 鳳鳴が水飲みアヒルみたいに何度もこくこくと頷く。パル店主はカウンターから上体を乗りだしてきた。
lines.english: Naru Otori bobbed her head over and over like a drinking bird. Paru leaned across the counter toward me.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたいドラ。しばらく会わない間にずいぶん素直ンなったじゃないか」
lines.english: “What's got into you, Dora? You've grown awfully straightforward since I last saw you.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか？　友達なんだからこのぐらい、べつに普通だと思うぞ」
lines.english: “Have I? She's my friend. I think this much is perfectly ordinary.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだけどさ、今までその普通も出来なかったのがあんたじゃないか」
lines.english: “It is. But you're the one who could never manage even that much ordinary behavior before.”

lines.japanese: 「はいー。やっぱりドラさん、感じ変わりましたねー、現段階では良い方にー」
lines.english: “Yes. You really have changed, Dora. At present, for the better.”

lines.japanese: 「なぁーん、もー。おまいら、そんなほめんなてー。兄ちゃん、てれちゃうでしょー」
lines.english: “Come ooon. Don't praise me so much. You'll embarrass your big brother.”

lines.japanese: 「あーでも私、あのくらい聞かん坊の方がワイルドで好みだったかもー」
lines.english: “Though maybe I preferred you when you were that stubborn. You were wilder then.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　うるせえよ小娘、口閉じろ口。おい、そこのピンク。おら４００円。てめ、これでもまだクレープよこさねーなら消費者センターに訴えンぞ。道交法違反とかも強調しちゃうからなコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Huh? Shut up, little girl. Close your mouth. Hey, Pinky. Here's four hundred yen. If you still don't hand over my crêpe, I'll report you to the consumer affairs office. I'll make sure to emphasize the traffic-law violations too, asshole.”

lines.japanese: パル店主はひひひと笑いながら、ようやくクレープの準備に取りかかった。
lines.english: Paru gave a wicked chuckle and finally began preparing the crêpe.

lines.japanese: そのあいだ俺と鳳鳴は、この二週間の出来事なんかを、だらだら冷やかしあいながら話した。
lines.english: While she worked, Naru Otori and I traded lazy jabs and talked through what had happened over the last two weeks.
